roads.name: Point Caswell Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 9 curves in 2.0 miles.
From 21 to 31 ft, with 44 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.75 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
